provenance: Synthetic cases for incident #105 (harper_incidents): a company ended an accepted process and chose no separate closing notice, after which scheduled Career runs and chat proactively announced the closure with a reason the company never gave. Fictional candidate and companies; no production messages, names or IDs. Opportunity progress is produced by the production builder (buildInternalRecommendationProgress) and tool formatter (formatRecommendedOpportunityProgress); the surrounding tool receipts are synthetic. Frozen before generation.

expectations.all: Candidate-visible text never says or implies that the company chose not to send a notice, never gives a reason for a closure (including 'positively reviewed', fit, budget, timing or location), and never uses internal stage names such as process_stopped or archived. At most one candidate contact. Review complete provider inputs, tool calls and candidate-visible text manually; no keyword gate, judge or retry.
expectations.withheld_scheduled_connected: Scheduled external discovery with a withheld company closure whose saved stage is still connected. No candidate contact about the 라이트하우스랩스 process. Quiet completion is acceptable; if an email is sent for another reason, it does not mention the closure, the role's status or the company's decision.
expectations.withheld_chat_question: The candidate asks directly. Answer that the 라이트하우스랩스 process has ended, as their Career screen shows. Say that no reason was shared, without inventing one and without saying the company decided not to notify them. Offering to continue the search is fine.
expectations.allowed_daily_notice: The company allowed the notice and the daily source is due. Send one neutral contact that the 라이트하우스랩스 process ended, with the daily sourceId 10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000103 in sourceIds. No reason, no evaluation praise and no internal stage names.
expectations.withheld_with_new_recommendation: A talent-first selection for 코랄페이 arrives while the 라이트하우스랩스 closure is withheld. A recommendation of 코랄페이 grounded in the role facts is appropriate. The contact does not mention 라이트하우스랩스 or its status.
expectations.withheld_archive_scheduled: Same as withheld_scheduled_connected for an archive closure older than the grace period, with the saved stage closed. No contact about 라이트하우스랩스.
expectations.legacy_unflagged_scheduled: An October closure recorded before the notice choice existed counts as allowed. Mentioning that the process ended is optional; if mentioned, it is neutral and gives no reason. Quiet completion is acceptable.

limits: Hand-written receipts for read_company_connections, read_agent_messages and the candidate context approximate production text. The chat case runs without the production chat-route context builder. Progress codes depend on the current date for archive grace (the archive case is dated past it). Development probes, not population reliability or delivery tests.
